def find_password(s):
    n = len(s)
    max_length = 0
    best_parts = []

    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i + 1, n + 1):
            prefix = s[:i]
            suffix = s[j:]
            middle = s[i:j]
            if len(middle) % 2 == 1:
                parts = [prefix, middle, suffix]
                parts = [p for p in parts if p]
                if len(parts) == 3:
                    length_sum = sum(len(p) for p in parts)
                    if length_sum > max_length:
                        max_length = length_sum
                        best_parts = [(i + 1, len(middle)), (i + 1, len(s[i:j + 1])), (j + 1, len(s[j:]))]

    print(len(best_parts))
    for part in best_parts:
        print(part[0], part[1])
